claim: Atorvastatin reduces LDL cholesterol in adults with hyperlipidemia

rows.n: pooled double-blind RCTs of statins in hypercholesterolaemia (>=12 weeks)
rows.finding: Dose-specific meta-analysis of double-blind RCTs: fixed-dose atorvastatin 10 mg lowered LDL-C by >30% from baseline (statins overall 24-49%), directly supporting atorvastatin's LDL-lowering effect in hypercholesterolaemia.
rows.integrity_note: No retraction or expression of concern found.

rows.n: 18 head-to-head trials (17 published + 1 unpublished; adults >=18 with elevated TC/LDL-C)
rows.finding: Dose-specific meta-analysis of atorvastatin-vs-simvastatin head-to-head RCTs found atorvastatin produced significantly greater LDL-C reductions in the majority of dose comparisons (2-4x the potency of simvastatin) in hyperlipidemic adults.
rows.integrity_note: No retraction or expression of concern found.

rows.finding: Individual-patient-data pooled meta-analysis found atorvastatin 10-80 mg lowered LDL-C dose-dependently, with each doubling of dose giving ~4-6% further LDL-C reduction.
rows.integrity_note: No retraction or expression of concern found.

rows.finding: Prospective meta-analysis of 14 statin RCTs (including atorvastatin trials) achieved mean 1-year LDL-C differences up to 1.77 mmol/L, confirming statins robustly lower LDL-C; class-level anchor for atorvastatin's mechanism.
rows.integrity_note: No retraction or expression of concern; only a standard 2005 erratum (Lancet 366(9494):1358).

rows.n: 2,838 (type 2 diabetes, primary prevention, LDL-C <=4.14 mmol/L at entry)
rows.finding: Placebo-controlled RCT of atorvastatin 10 mg/day lowered LDL-C and reduced major cardiovascular events by 37%; direct atorvastatin trial evidence, but the population is type 2 diabetics enrolled at non-elevated LDL-C rather than a hyperlipidemia cohort.
rows.integrity_note: No retraction or expression of concern found.

rows.citation: Karlson 2015 (VOYAGER), European Journal of Preventive Cardiology
rows.finding: VOYAGER pooled RCT analysis quantified dose-dependent atorvastatin LDL-C lowering (e.g. atorvastatin ~15 mg is equipotent to the ~39% LDL-C reduction of rosuvastatin 5 mg; higher atorvastatin doses give larger reductions), confirming dose-dependent LDL-C lowering.
rows.integrity_note: No retraction or expression of concern found.

provenance: Gathered in-window from PubMed/ClinicalTrials.gov (public). PMIDs/NCTs/DOIs only; no Consensus output redistributed.
